quest.title: A Little Game
quest.description: You met a strange person on Mt. Tianheng who is looking for someone to play hide-and-seek with him...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3, Mora x20000

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure, I love that game!

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Yay! Alright, let the game begin!

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Um, but gimme a sec first... I haven't thought where to hide...

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: ...Okay, I got it! Hehehe, you'll never find me!

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Ready?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm ready!

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Okay! Uh, on your marks... get ready... let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Nah, I'm fine.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: So, are you ready?

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Ah, you finally found me! Was it that obvious?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It was pretty obvious...

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Really? How could that be? When I hid here, even my father couldn't find me...

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Hmph. We've only just begun. I haven't used my full power yet!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Okay.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Aha, you finally found me.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Hee-hee, was I well hidden or what? This is my secret hiding place. Even Mommy can't find me here!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That tree doesn't hide you completely.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: I don't believe you! I'm tiny and this tree hides me perfectly, even Daddy says so.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: My dad's really tall and it even hides him. There's no way it could hide him but not me.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Anyway, I guess you're just really good at this game. Let's play again!

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Hmph, this time I'm gonna hide way out of sight. I know just the place, Daddy picked it for me...

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: My daddy's a Millelith, and he says that there's no one better than him at being stealthy.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Every time we've played hide-and-seek before, Mommy can never ever find me and Daddy until Daddy comes out on purpose... Or if Mommy yells at him to come out, that works too.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: ...Have you ever even played this game before?

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Ugh, it's hopeless... You'll never find me at this rate.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Look out for a <color=#00E1FFFF>tree on the slope to the northwest</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Surely you must be able to find me now... Let's give it another try.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: What do you think of my daddy's specially chosen hiding place? Pretty well hidden, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It wasn't that hard to find.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Really? Well... At least, Mommy can never find me and Daddy when we're hiding here.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: You found me! Hehehe...

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Even Mommy's never found this place. One day, she suddenly said she wanted to play hide-and-seek with me, with me as the hider and her as the seeker.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: So I went to a special hiding place that Daddy once told me about, and sure enough she couldn't find me at all. Then, I heard loads up people walking up the mountain...

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: I thought it must've been Mommy getting all her friends to help look for me. So I hid even further inside.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: After a few days, she still hadn't found me. I thought she might be worried, and I was also a little hungry... so I came out. But she still didn't find me.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Maybe Mommy got mad because I was so well hidden that she couldn't find me? Still... I'd have thought that Mommy or Daddy would've found me by now, after such a long time...

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: But anyway, thanks for playing with me for so long. Mommy and Daddy always said I shouldn't take up too much of other people's time, and that when I get somebody to do something for me, I should always repay them.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: So here you go, take these. They're from the hiding place that Daddy picked out for me.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: This one time, a guy brought some food for me, and I wanted to repay him too, but he wouldn't take it. I have no idea why...

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Okay, I'm going home. You can carry on with your other stuff now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yeah, I need a rest.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Ah, you found me! Was it that obvious?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It was pretty obvious...

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Really? How could that be? When I hid here, even my father couldn't find me...

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Hmph. We've only just begun. I haven't used my full power yet!

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Hee-hee, see? Told you you'd never find me, didn't I!

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Well, since it's your first time playing, I'll give you a little clue.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: I'm hiding <color=#00E1FFFF>behind a rock</color>. You just gotta a look a little harder! You wanna carry on playing?

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Still can't find me?

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Seems like I'm pretty good at this! Hmm... Maybe I should go easier on you.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: I'm hiding <color=#00E1FFFF>to the north</color>. You just gotta a look a little harder! You wanna carry on playing?

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Was I really so well hidden? Hmm, this must be getting pretty boring for you if you can't find me.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: I'm hiding near a <color=#00E1FFFF>a big rock to the north</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Alright, let's go again shall we? Surely you'll be able to find me this time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I need a break.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Ah, you found me!

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Hee-hee, was I well hidden or what? This is my secret hiding place. Even Mommy can't find me here!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That tree doesn't hide you completely.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Anyway, I guess you're just really good at this game. Let's play again!

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Hmph, this time I'm gonna hide way out of sight. I know just the place, Daddy picked it for me...

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: My daddy's a Millelith, and he says that there's no one better than him at being stealthy.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Every time we've played hide-and-seek before, Mommy can never ever find me and Daddy until Daddy comes out on purpose... Or if Mommy yells at him to come out, that works too.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Give up?

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Hmm... Okay, I'll give you a little clue. This time, I'll be hiding <color=#00E1FFFF>near one of the trees round here</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Let's have another round, you'll definitely be able to find me this time. Well? You wanna carry on playing?

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Still couldn't find me? Maybe you're just not very good at this kind of game...

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Here's a tip: Try looking <color=#00E1FFFF>further northwest</color>. I'm hiding over that way.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Let's go again. You ready?

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: What do you think of my daddy's specially chosen hiding place? Pretty well hidden, right?

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Haha, guess you couldn't find me after all?

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Well, it is a pretty neat hiding place. My daddy found it for me, even Mommy can't find me there.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: There's no way you can compete with my daddy at this game, so I'll have to give you a clue. My hiding place is <color=#00E1FFFF>nearby that house over there</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: See, you couldn't find me, right? Haha, well this hiding place was picked by my dad, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: I'll have to give you a clue, otherwise you'll never find me. So, try heading <color=#00E1FFFF>east</color> next time.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Let's go again! You can do it, you just need to look a little harder.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Couldn't find me, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Don't feel bad — my daddy found the hiding place for me, so normal people would never be able to find it.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Here's a tip: Look out for <color=#00E1FFFF>hidey holes around that house to the east</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: As tips go, that was a pretty big one. So surely you should be able to find me now.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Let's go again! You can do it, you just need to look a little harder.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: You found me! Hehehe...

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Hmm... Well, this is the ultimate hiding place, I guess.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Okay, a hint: I'm hiding <color=#00E1FFFF>by the cliff</color>. Look carefully!

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Let's give it another go.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Still can't find me... Alright, I guess you're allowed another clue.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: The clue is: Look further <color=#00E1FFFF>south</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Got it? Let's try again, you should be able to find me this time.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: My ultimate hiding place is even better than I thought. Seems like you'll never find me there...

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Since you're having so much trouble finding me... Try looking by the <color=#00E1FFFF>big cliff at the south</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Hee-hee... Who knows what you might find there — maybe me!

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Looks like this was kinda hard work for you.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Let's play again.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: This time, I'm gonna hide in the best hiding place ever. You'll never find me!

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Bet you won't find me this time!

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Okay, this time I'm gonna go to... my ultimate hiding place! You'll never find me there.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Actually, I need a break.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: My hiding place is <color=#00E1FFFF>behind a rock</color>. Do you wanna carry on playing hide-and-seek with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It was pretty hard to find.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: See? See? Whenever me and Daddy hide here, Mommy can never find us and always has to tell us to come out.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Daddy's even hidden a load of cool stuff here like snacks, wine, and even some Mora! Daddy says I'm not supposed to tell Mommy about that part though.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: But then this one time just as Daddy was leaving the house, he went and told Mommy about all the places where he was hiding stuff anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: But whatever, some of the stuff that goes on between mommies and daddies isn't meant for kids to understand. Let's keep playing, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I managed...

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: It's okay, there's no shame in admitting you found this a tough challenge. It is the ultimate hiding place, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It was a little tough.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Haha, well, this is the ultimate hiding place after all. It's normal that finding it was a challenge.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Are you ready to play hide-and-seek with me now?

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Let's play.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: This time, I'm gonna hide in the best hiding place ever. You'll never find me!

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Bet you won't find me this time!

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Okay, this time I'm gonna go to... my ultimate hiding place! You'll never find me there.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Looks like this was kinda hard work for you.
